steps: all characters outside [word char, whitespace, apostrophe, Cyrillic block, hyphen] replaced by a space
whitespace collapsed to single spaces and stripped

tokenization.wer: whitespace split of the normalized text
tokenization.cer: character sequence of the normalized text with spaces removed

forbidden_operations_not_performed: rewriting the human reference in the source artifact
note: the human-review artifact is never rewritten; normalization is computed in memory only
